Area.evidence_source: Then you go through 'the pit' and then you come up with these errors of thought that you cannot get rid of [...]. You just get stuck in this pit and it takes a lot of time to work yourself out of it. Then you go on to plan... what is the easiest way... you know... the thoughts develop into suicidal thoughts because it's just so comfortable... This is a very lonely feeling because it really does not matter what kind of help you get, what friends or family you have, there's really no one who can help you. There is no one there except you and the thoughts that are with you. Then you start to think what the best way is [to end your life].
